notes: This paper is based on video recordings of infants: 51 infants participated in seven fortnightly assessments at postterm ages of 4–16 weeks. Infants were presented with the same set of static and dynamic paired comparison stimuli in each assessment. Visual behavior was evaluated by a newly introduced scoring scheme.
